children.name: Leoheo domatiophorus Chaowasku, D.T.Ngo & Hung T.Le
children.description: Habitat and phenology. – Occurring in (edges of) evergreen forests, disturbed evergreen forests, or edges of secondarforests adjacent to the primary ones; on a steep hillside or near a stream at 270 – 350 m. Flowering material collected in March. Fruiting material collected in July.
